profile.headline: Software Developer at REGO CONSULTING
profile.summary:
Mobile applications developer focused on visually pleasing, performant, maintainable, and intuitive user experiences.

Adaptable to the fast-paced mobile applications environment with a keen eye for reliable, testable and extensible libraries and frameworks.

I maintain a personal library of tools that makes future projects quicker to develop. I enjoy coding reusable pieces of code.

I am a semi-active user on various forums such as StackOverflow and the Flutter Discord channel because I Iike helping others with their various challenges and solving issues.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Built and shipped a complete Time Entry module in Flutter: task/work-item picker, daily hour/minute inputs, weekly organization (sticky headers, collapsible sections), filtering/controls, validation + confirmation flows, change tracking, and polished animations.

* Integrated Microsoft Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM) on iOS and Android, bridging native SDKs/packages into Flutter to meet enterprise security and compliance requirements.

* Implemented Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) push notifications (foreground/background/terminated) with payload parsing and action handling, plus Firestore DB backed device registration/token management (minimal user data) and local SQLite persistence for received notifications.

* Delivered near-real-time refresh with version-based synchronization/concurrency control to prevent stale or invalid updates and maintain UI to back-end consistency.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed various mobile apps across different platforms using Swift and Flutter, focusing on company needs. Utilized best practices, design patterns, and framework methods for efficient, reliable, and flexible solutions with beautiful animations and an intuitive UI/UX.

Tech: Flutter, Swift, Firebase, Bloc, iOS CallKit, Web Sockets, Platform Channels.

Applications:

Electronic form applications different departments (IT, Planners, Drivers, Legal + Medical consent forms):
  * Robust document system with automatic backups, uploads, conversion to PDF and cleanup.
  * Custom camera application integration, finger/stylus drawn signatures, auto-fill, validated fields.
  * Multi-platform (works on any device) electronic documents convertible to and from JSON/PDF.

Route planning application:
  * Enabled real-time communication between planners and drivers via web socket connection.
  * Easy to use drag & drop patient organization + planning.
  * Admin dashboard to manage vehicles, view driver documents/reports, etc.
  * Appointment filtering/search and modification.

Driver application:
  * Real-time updates from and to the device, such as route and patient modifications.
  * Vehicle odometer tracking via inspection data, ensuring proper maintenance.
  * Location tracking + call monitoring, automatic announcements, settings serialization.

Apple TV Remote Manager + TV playback across multiple locations (clinics, wellness centers, stores):
  * Network issue detection and recovery for continuous video playback i.e. minimal downtime.
  * Device management of many Apple TV's from a single application.
  * Allows user to create playlists, and execute remote commands on Apple TV's.
positions.insights: Design Patterns, Swift (Programming Language) and +9 skills
